hits.name: Codie Sanchez
hits.hook: You need to become addicted to finishing what you started.
hits.text: You need to become addicted to finishing what you started.
hits.draft_en:
Your best market isn't the busiest one.

It's the one where you made the most per hour.

Count the booth fee, the gas, the setup and teardown hours. Then decide which shows you go back to.
hits.video_tip: 10s talking head while packing up the car after a show. Say the first two lines to camera, then cut to a handwritten per-hour calculation for that day using your own real numbers.

hits.name: Codie Sanchez
hits.hook: I wish I had this product 10 years ago as a CEO.
hits.text:
I wish I had this product 10 years ago as a CEO.

A live financial command center built into your business. 

It shows: 

→ where do you stand on growth targets
→ what are the bottlenecks slowing you down
→ what's actually driving revenue and what isn’t

So you can spot problems early and always know what’s stopping the business from growing.

One thing we hear all the time from owners inside our scaling advisory is their books aren’t clean enough and they don’t know what to prioritize. 

Now they can just upload their P&L + docs and get a full diagnostic of their business.

You can’t fix what you can’t measure.
hits.draft_en:
I wish I had this my first craft show season.

One screen that tells you how your booth actually did.

It shows:

→ what sold, by item and by hour
→ what you really earned per hour after booth fee, gas, and materials
→ which markets are worth booking again

Most vendors guess at all three. You can't fix what you can't measure.

That's what we're building CraftDesk to do. Start tracking these three at your next market.
hits.video_tip: 15-20s phone screen recording right after a market: scroll sales by hour, land on the per-hour number, then the 'book again?' list. Put each arrow line on screen as text as you hit it.

hits.name: Codie Sanchez
hits.hook: It's wild how much you can get done when you:
hits.text:
It's wild how much you can get done when you:

- silence your phone
- put on headphones
- lock in for 1 hour straight
- delete social apps
- close email 
- listen to loud music
hits.draft_en:
It's wild how much more you sell at a market when you:

- price every item where buyers can see it
- take cards, not just cash
- put your bestseller at eye level, front and center
- stand up instead of sitting behind the table
- say hi before they pick anything up
- restock the front row by noon

Which one are you skipping this weekend?
hits.video_tip: 20-30s time-lapse of a booth setup. Flash each bullet as on-screen text the moment you do it. End on the finished booth and the question as a caption.

hits.name: Codie Sanchez
hits.text:
"You’re just another media company.”

What our “just a xxx company” looks like 7 years in:

- 18,726 owners and entrepreneurs taught
- $3.5M spent building our acquisition software
- 2nd largest business marketplace with over 183,000 users

- $2M+ building our scaling software
- $918M in our lending pipeline for small biz acquisitions
- Zero outside funding for main biz
- 100+ deals closed a year

Don’t listen to the trolls. Keep building.
